sources.note: Sec. 1.5 Spelling: 'Most of the data used in this study has not yet been phonemicized; the spelling is therefore phonetic and for practical reasons follows Pike 1947', followed by a symbol-deviation table by language group; Morafa items appear only as phonetic forms in c. 60 cognate sets (e.g. 'WAR.. c ose', 'c orAm'). No stress or tone marks and no prosodic remark for any Warup language. Wordlist/comparative data only - not a statement.
